name: Sewer Junction
author: voodoo573
description: A four-way junction of brick sewer tunnels with water channels meeting in a central basin. Walkways run along each channel, with two plank bridges, a drain grate, a ladder up to a manhole, pillars, rubble and a few crates. 22 x 22 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Four-way sewer tunnel junction with channels and walkways.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
